observed_value: 2 duplicate position keys reported for media telecommunications iheartcommunications inc
anchor_value: source schedule shows two distinct iHeartCommunications bond positions with different interest rates, maturity dates, principal amounts, amortized costs, and fair values
rationale: B02 flagged duplicate position keys for iHeartCommunications, Inc., but the 2025 raw schedule separates the same issuer into two corporate bond instruments. Table 251 row 21 carries 9.13% due 5/1/2029 with principal 110,967, amortized cost 108,484, and fair value 106,963; row 22 carries 10.88% due 5/1/2030 with principal 171,258, amortized cost 163,600, and fair value 148,143. The duplicate-key fire is therefore caused by a key/check that collapses distinct instrument terms, not by duplicated source data.
